links.note: Design for open idea IDEA-20261029-2e292c; not yet approved or dispatched.

question: Does a witness-blind, instance-computable backdoor cut leave a cheaper complete residual than equal-entropy random cuts and best fixed-block guessing on tiny exact digit-system instances?

claims.text: Every candidate cut's residual is certified by exhaustive enumeration over the frozen tiny instances, so a claimed strong backdoor with one unresolved legal assignment is detected.
The witness-blind policy's total backdoor solve cost is at least 2x lower than both equal-entropy random cuts and best fixed-block guessing at the same entropy.
claims.if_supported: the claim holds within the frozen cells and instrument named here
claims.if_not_supported: the claim is refuted within the frozen cells; report the direction and effect

hypotheses.statement: A small instance-computable backdoor chosen without any witness reduces complete residual cost by at least 2x against equal-entropy random and fixed-block cuts.
hypotheses.mechanism: Conditioning a small set of carry or intermediate variables splits the system; if the split is chosen from instance structure rather than the solution, the residual branches shrink faster than a uniform-entropy cut.

arms.description: best fixed-block guessing at matched entropy
instance-computable cut chosen without any witness
equal-entropy random cuts on the same instances
planted synthetic circuit with a known small strong backdoor
matched algebraic null with no planted structure

positive.expected_detection: the planted small backdoor is recovered

null_population.description: matched algebraic null instances with no planted backdoor
null_population.generator: matched algebraic null instances with no planted backdoor
null_population.why_n: enough independent null draws to resolve the stated alpha under the family correction; the null is exact where the proposal states an exact count, and sampled otherwise

primary.name: total backdoor solve cost

primary.formula: selection cost plus every residual branch cost, summed, per verified relation

stopping_rules.rule: fixed: every frozen tiny instance x five cut policies, exhaustive residual enumeration, then stop

invalidation_rules: a row whose instrument hash differs from the frozen build is excluded and reported
a control that fails its expected detection voids the clean cells it was meant to protect

decision_rule.text: C-gain is supported when the witness-blind cut costs at most 0.5x both baselines at equal verified model counts and full exception coverage; one unresolved legal assignment in a purported strong backdoor refutes it, and a policy that needs known roots or test tuning is inadmissible.
decision_rule.threshold: cost ratio <=0.5 against both baselines with equal verified model counts
decision_rule.statistic: the primary metric named in C2, pooled as the proposal specifies
decision_rule.interval: Clopper-Pearson or bootstrap 95% as the metric states

inadmissible: treating lower first-fall degree as lower solving cost
tuning the policy on test instances
